prompt: Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One vintage hand-crank sewing machine in three-quarter view with a large clear flywheel, curved body, visible needle arm and a folded cloth on the base. Essential rendering rule: flat OUTLINE ART for a child's tracing activity. Pure white interiors and pure white background; ONLY dark ink contour strokes. No gray gradients, shadows, dense hatching, hair strands, woodgrain or fine textures. Whole composition comfortably inside the square with clear margins. Draw only the specified subject, no unrelated additional toys, animals or people. If beginner, the fewest essential large forms; if medium, a few thoughtful structural details.
